narrative.headline: The Stars are the team on the rise
narrative.blurb: 47 games on this week's slate. The Oilers are No. 1 at 3-0-1 with a +6 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Penguins on 5 points. The West's last spot is the Sharks on 6 points. The Stars lead the heat check at 2-1-0 and +8 goals over the last three games.
